The machine learning platform architect mandates that all distributed training jobs log communication profile summaries to wandb before exiting.", "output": "Finalize the operational architecture and workload scheduling specification for our multi-tenant GPU cloud platform according to the following requirements:

1. We need to finalize the operational architecture and workload scheduling specification for our multi-tenant GPU cloud platform.
2. The compute cluster manages 512 Nvidia H100 GPUs distributed across 64 compute nodes connected via 800 Gbps InfiniBand fabric.
3. The GPU device manager in device_manager.cpp partitions physical GPUs using Multi-Instance GPU configuration slicing each H100 into 4 isolated compute instances with dedicated high-bandwidth memory.
4. CUDA kernel scheduling in kernel_scheduler.cpp assigns priority queues to tenant workloads guaranteeing bounded kernel launch latency under 200 microseconds.
5. For deep learning inference serving the Triton inference server cluster in triton_orchestrator.cpp configures dynamic batching with max queue delay set to 10 milliseconds and max batch size of 64 requests.
6. Tensor parallelism communication in nccl_coordinator.cpp optimizes multi-GPU all-reduce primitives across NVLink 4 interconnects achieving 900 GB/s bidirectional bandwidth.
7. To eliminate PCIe bus transfer bottlenecks the memory staging manager in pinned_memory_pool.cpp pre-allocates 32 GB of host pinned memory per node for zero-copy direct memory access transfers.
8. During distributed training runs checkpoint_manager.py coordinates asynchronous model state snapshotting to local NVMe scratch volumes formatted with ext4.
9. Once local snapshot creation completes snapshot_sync.py streams compressed checkpoint archives to Ceph object storage using Zstandard level 3 compression.
10. Site reliability engineers must monitor GPU cluster health on the primary Prometheus dashboard tracking GPU utilization, tensor core throttling, and PCIe bus error rates.
11. The GPU compute utilization threshold must remain above 85% across all active nodes during production training runs.
12. If PCIe bus fatal error counters increment in nvidia-smi telemetry the cluster automated remediation agent in node_drainer.py must immediately cordon the affected compute node.
13. Job preemption policies in priority_scheduler.cpp allow high-priority real-time inference workloads to preempt background fine-tuning jobs with a 30-second checkpoint grace period.
14. The infrastructure security architect mandates that tenant container runtimes enforce Nvidia container toolkit isolation preventing unprivileged access to host kernel modules.
15. Network isolation policies in calico_network.yaml must enforce strict virtual private cloud segmentation restricting inter-node traffic to authorized tenant subnets.
16. Audit logging agents in security_audit.py must record all privileged container execution events and send structured logs to /var/log/gpu_audit.log.
17. The disaster recovery coordinator requires automated daily failover drills simulating loss of an entire compute rack with automated workload rescheduling completed within 5 minutes.
18. The lead systems engineer mandates automated integration tests verifying that CUDA driver version 12.4 and NCCL library version 2.20 are standardized across all cluster worker images before deployment.
19. Thermal throttling monitors in thermal_guard.cpp must alert on-call hardware operators when GPU die temperature exceeds 80 degrees Celsius.
20. Power capping configurations in power_manager.py must restrict maximum GPU power draw to 700 watts per board during peak power grid demand events.
21. The machine learning operations director requires verifying sustained training throughput of 95% linear scaling across 256 GPUs before approving production rollout.
22. The cluster scheduling coordinator in cluster_coordinator.cpp must implement gang scheduling to ensure all distributed training worker pods start simultaneously.
23. Memory bandwidth throttling in bandwidth_limiter.cpp must restrict background data loader processes to 50 GB/s to avoid starving tensor core computations.
24. The network telemetry monitor in infiniband_monitor.py must track link bit error rates across all optical transceiver cables alerting on signal degradation.
25. In addition automated container image caching in image_cache.py must pre-pull deep learning container images to local NVMe caches across all worker nodes.
26. Site reliability engineers must configure automated Prometheus alert rules in gpu_alerts.yaml notifying on-call engineers when GPU memory utilization exceeds 95%.
27. The Chief Information Officer requires daily automated backup verification of model checkpoints to secondary cloud storage.
28. The cluster telemetry agent in dcgm_exporter.py must collect per-GPU metrics including tensor core utilization, DRAM memory frequency, and NVLink error counters every 5 seconds.
29. Dynamic workload rescheduling in scheduler_balancer.cpp must migrate long-running training jobs onto nodes with lowest thermal stress.
30. The cloud infrastructure team mandates automated kernel crash dump collection archiving crash logs to centralized Elasticsearch clusters.
31. The Chief Technology Officer requires that all deep learning training containers enforce strict CPU and memory limits preventing noisy neighbor interference.
32. The hardware management daemon in bmc_telemetry.py must monitor power supply efficiency and chassis airflow fan speeds every 15 seconds.
33. Site reliability engineers must alert data center infrastructure operations if ambient rack temperatures exceed 25 degrees Celsius.
34. The machine learning platform architect mandates that all distributed training jobs log communication profile summaries to wandb before exiting."}]
